_comment: Update 13 'Rookie Camp' (src/core/onboarding.gd). 'features': the hub's progressive unlock order. A feature opens at account level 'level' or once Rookie Path step 'path' is claimed (whichever comes first); every feature opens for an established manager (account level 5+, 5+ games, or flags.unlock_all). Locked features stay visible as teasers with 'Unlocks at level N'. 'hub' names the hub element the NEW FEATURE UNLOCKED spotlight points at. 'rookie_week': a 7-day bonus calendar for new managers (one claim per calendar day; a missed day pauses it, it never resets); 'choice' lets the player pick a card of that rarity. 'early_games': a bonus pack for each of the first games. 'consolation': a loss in the first 'games' games pays 'reward' and offers an easier difficulty; 'coach_losses' losses in a row also suggest Auto Build. 'welcome_back': after 'days' days away, 'reward' (or 'reward_long' after 'long_days'), with the recap card. 'badge_budget': attention badges a new manager sees on the hub at once, by 'badge_priority' (first = most important).
